rationale: The landlord confirms that his repair company has fixed the washing machine, and that his operative has ordered a part for the towel rail (023). The agency recorded that the landlord had dealt with it and completed the job without payment (024, 025). Closing the washing-machine job is right. Keeping it open with a dated check on the towel rail, a separate landlord-managed item, is acceptable. The landlord's own contractors did the work, so there is no agency invoice to approve and nothing to charge the tenant.
